spec.claim_summary: Base buy when 4-hour RSI(14) drops below 28 with five scaled averaging orders and 3% take-profit on averaged entry with no stop-loss.
spec.untestable_reason: Strategy requires a five-rung averaging ladder with size scaling and take-profit on the averaged entry, which needs multiple positions and cannot be tested as a single-position rule.
assumptions: Asset is ETHUSDT from page context; the claim text itself names no asset.
Timeframe is 4h from the claim phrase '4h RSI(14)'.
Direction is long inferred from base and averaging buy orders with take-profit above entry.
'drops below 28' compiled as crosses_below 28 rather than holding below 28.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Five averaging orders at -2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25% with 1.8x size scaling per rung cannot be expressed; the engine tests one position at a time so only the base order is shown.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Take-profit 3% above ladder-averaged entry cannot be expressed as a fixed 3% from base entry, so no target is encoded because the average price depends on which rungs filled.
No stop-loss per claim; ladder allocation as structural risk cap is position sizing with no stop representation.
Test period cited in the claim is recorded in claimed and is not part of the rule.

evidence.quote: A base order fires when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28
